inject.template:

" + time($unix, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + "
" + time($unix, "%Y%m%d") + "/us-east-1/sts/aws4_request
" + hex(sha256($method + "
" + $pathname + "
" + canonical_query($query) + "
host:" + $host + "
x-amz-date:" + time($unix, "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ") + "

host;x-amz-date
" + hex(sha256($body)))))) }}
